Operation ID: `get_players_by_account_id_select_totals`.

### SDK call

```ts
const { data, meta } = await client.get("/players/{account_id}/totals", {
  path: { account_id: "123456789" },
});
```

### Parameters

#### Path parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | `DecimalId` | Yes | Not specified | Steam32 account ID Decimal string identifier. |

#### Query parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | `number` | No | Not specified | Number of matches to limit to Integer. |
| `offset` | `number` | No | Not specified | Number of matches to offset start by Integer. |
| `win` | `0 \| 1 \| boolean` | No | Not specified | Whether the player won |
| `patch` | `number` | No | Not specified | Patch ID, from dotaconstants Integer. |
| `game_mode` | `number` | No | Not specified | Game Mode ID Integer. |
| `lobby_type` | `number` | No | Not specified | Lobby type ID Integer. |
| `region` | `number` | No | Not specified | Region ID Integer. |
| `date` | `number` | No | Not specified | Days previous Integer. |
| `lane_role` | `number` | No | Not specified | Lane Role ID Integer. |
| `hero_id` | `number` | No | Not specified | Hero ID Integer. |
| `is_radiant` | `0 \| 1 \| boolean` | No | Not specified | Whether the player was radiant |
| `included_account_id` | Array of `DecimalId` | No | Not specified | Account IDs in the match (array) |
| `excluded_account_id` | Array of `DecimalId` | No | Not specified | Account IDs not in the match (array) |
| `with_hero_id` | Array of `number` | No | Not specified | Hero IDs on the player's team (array) |
| `against_hero_id` | Array of `number` | No | Not specified | Hero IDs against the player's team (array) |
| `significant` | `number` | No | `1` (provider description) | Whether the match was significant for aggregation purposes. Defaults to 1 (true), set this to 0 to return data for non-standard modes/matches. Integer. |
| `having` | `number` | No | Not specified | The minimum number of games played, for filtering hero stats Integer. |
| `sort` | `string` | No | Not specified | The field to return matches sorted by in descending order |

### Success response

HTTP `200`; content type `application/json; charset=utf-8`. Success

The SDK resolves to `OpenDotaResult<Data>`. `data` has the shape: Array of [`PlayerTotalsResponse`](../schemas.md#playertotalsresponse). `meta` is documented in [Response metadata](../client.md#results-and-metadata).

```ts
import type { ResponseData } from '@reino-doce/opendota-client';

type Data = ResponseData<"/players/{account_id}/totals", "get">;
```
